sheet.text: Clean up nomenclature in the Abi constants brigade.  Purge magic GEP numbers in trans.  Adjust obj_closure_rty (and its consumers) to be more explicit about the fact that it is a box.
Bulk-edit compile commands in emacs chatter to point to assumed build/ dir off src root.
Another go at changing compile-command, this time using RBUILD env var.
Reformat a bunch of recent churn.
Move everything syntax-related to syntax/, break deps on rest of compiler
rustc: Revert the conversion to interior vectors due to heap corruption
Remove all uses of tuples from the compiler and stdlib
Port the stdlib to the ivec type [T] syntax.
Port the compiler to the ivec type [T] syntax.
Port the stdlib to the typaram foo<T> syntax.
Port the compiler to the typaram foo<T> syntax.
Port the stdlib to the decl foo<T> syntax.
Port the stdlib to the expr foo::<T> syntax.
Port the compiler to the expr foo::<T> syntax.
Remove or _-prefix all unused function arguments
Move functions from syntax::ast to syntax::ast_util
Parse and typecheck by-value and by-ref arg specs
remove compile-command from local variable blocks
Make driver::session::session no longer an object
rustdoc: Rename mk_srv_from_str/file to just from_str/file
stdlib: Stop incurring vtable dispatch costs when hashmaps are used
stdlib: Stop incurring vtable dispatch costs when hashmaps are used
std: Rename the hashmap constructors to conform to new standards
add mut decls to rustc and make them mandatory
rustc: Remove the rustsyntax::attr wrapper in front
make nominal types optionally parameterized by a self region.
Start parsing pub/priv on regular items
First cut at dtors for classes
Annotate or fix FIXMEs in LLVM bindings and metadata code
rustc: Move ast_map to the syntax crate
Adding shared_arc to hide some of the tedium of sharing an arc between tasks.
Get rid of little-used logging fns in util::common.  Closes #2553.
Move vector addition out of trans and into libcore.
Getting rid of lots more vector +=. (issue #2719)
Merge branch 'master' of github.com:mozilla/rust into incoming
Change 'iface' to 'trait' internally; parse `trait` as `iface` synonym
